heading: 50/50 Raffle — In Person Only
intro: The VIP Sponsor Dinner, Lakewood event, Piano Guys concert and Fairlawn Meet & Greet each have their own 50/50 raffle. Buy tickets from raffle volunteers at the event you’re attending.

events.name: An Evening with Cast Members from The Chosen

closing: Each event has its own entries, jackpot, drawing and winner. Tickets are valid only for the raffle at the event where they’re sold.
sunday: There will be no raffle at Sunday's November 15 event at Mayfield United Methodist Church.
prize: The winner at each event receives 50% of that event’s gross raffle ticket sales. Processing fees and operating expenses come from Kirtland Heritage Group’s half.
